title: Operator and Function Overloading in Custom Python Classes
description: Use Python operator overloading to make built-in functions and operators work with your own classes, and write more Pythonic code.
summary: This is called operator overloading or function overloading respectively. This article will help you understand this mechanism, so that you can do the same in your own Python classes and make your objects more Pythonic .
